test_cases.name: Valid CycloneDX 1.7 BOM generation and official schema validation
test_cases.details: specVersion=1.7, $schema=http://cyclonedx.org/schema/bom-1.7.schema.json, validated against official CycloneDX 1.7 JSON Schema, cyclonedx-go v0.12.0 SDK decoder, and project ML-BOM profile

test_cases.name: Valid CycloneDX 1.6 BOM backward-compatibility validation
test_cases.details: specVersion=1.6, $schema=http://cyclonedx.org/schema/bom-1.6.schema.json, validated against official CycloneDX 1.6 JSON Schema

test_cases.name: Invalid required fields (missing bomFormat / missing metadata.timestamp)
Unknown top-level or nested properties
test_cases.details: Rejected with ErrInvalidBOM via strict JSON decoding and schema additionalProperties:false

test_cases.name: Invalid component type
test_cases.details: Rejected with ErrInvalidBOM by official bom-1.7.schema.json enum and semantic validator

test_cases.name: Missing file component (bundle vs BOM discrepancy)
test_cases.details: Rejected with ErrInvalidBOM (1-to-1 file inventory check)

test_cases.name: Extra file component not present in bundle
test_cases.details: Rejected with ErrInvalidBOM (1-to-1 file inventory check)

test_cases.name: Wrong file SHA-256 digest
test_cases.details: Rejected with ErrInvalidBOM on digest mismatch

test_cases.name: Invalid PEFT/LoRA pedigree (tampered ancestor name, wrong ancestor type, or missing pedigree)
Incorrect model metadata (mismatched modelCard.modelParameters or modelCard on file component)
Invalid dependency relationship (dangling dependsOn ref or unlinked component)
Official spdx.schema.json license enum validation & serialNumber/model_bundle_id separation
test_cases.details: Normalized observed 'apache-2.0' to SPDX 'Apache-2.0'; rejected invalid SPDX license IDs; rejected serialNumber == model_bundle_id
